name: Allie's Scalp
descriptiton: Once per Trial, downing a Tortured Survivor with a basic-attack applies Terrified.

name: Blackened Heart
descriptiton: After Taunting a Survivor, downing a Survivor with a Toy grants that Toy +1 extra Deadliness point.

name: Bottle of Bleach
descriptiton: Decreases Torture decay rate by -15 %.

name: Mike's Phone
descriptiton: Hitting a non-regressing Generator with a Toy causes it to lose -5 % progress and start regressing.

name: Bloodstained Bullet
descriptiton: Shooting a Survivor further than 16 metres away grants +10 % Status Effect for 10 seconds. When you apply Torture, the next Bag of Toys search is guaranteed to contain the Handgun.

name: Brooke's Pustule
descriptiton: While standing in the Acid Puddle and for 5 seconds after, increase basic-breaking speed of Pallets and Breakable Walls by +25 %. When you apply Torture, the next Bag of Toys search is guaranteed to contain the Acid Bottle.

name: Burnt Wings
descriptiton: Increases the duration of Flames by +5 seconds. When you apply Torture, the next Bag of Toys search is guaranteed to contain the Flamethrower.

name: Shiny Tricycle
descriptiton: When the Bike Horn detects more than 1 Survivor, reveal other Survivors who were not detected for 8 seconds. When you apply Torture, the next Bag of Toys search is guaranteed to contain the Bike Horn.

name: Sienna's Flesh
descriptiton: Increases the range of the Flail by +20 %. When you apply Torture, the next Bag of Toys search is guaranteed to contain the Flail.

name: Candy Head Bowl
descriptiton: Detecting a Survivor with the Bike Horn resets Bag of Toys cool-down.

name: Dead Opossum
descriptiton: Hitting a Survivor with the Handgun or the Flail reveals all other Survivor locations within 24 metres for 3 seconds.

name: Emily
descriptiton: Toys available in the Bag of Toys appear in a set order: Bike Horn, Handgun, Flamethrower, Flail, Acid Bottle.

name: Thornton Salt
descriptiton: Tortured Survivors suffer from Mangled and Haemorrhage Status Effects. These effects linger for 40 seconds after Torture is removed.

name: Victoria's Eye
descriptiton: Hitting a Survivor with the Acid Bottle or the Flamethrower reveals their aura for 5 seconds.

name: Art Crispies
descriptiton: When you Torture a Survivor, you both gain between +5 % and +15 % Haste Status Effect for 5 seconds.

name: Explosive Gift
descriptiton: For each Toy with maximum Deadliness, reduce your Terror Radius size by -20 %.

name: Jonathan's Skull
descriptiton: Damaging or Torturing a Survivor with a Toy grants 1 Token, up to 10 Tokens. Manually Taunting consumes all Tokens then, if at least 1 Token was consumed, reveal all Survivor auras within 8 metres plus +2 metres per Token for 6 seconds.

name: Wacky Jacks
descriptiton: Reduces maximum possible Deadliness points by -1 point to 5 points.

name: Duct Tape
descriptiton: Equipping a Toy within 0.5 seconds of opening the Bag of Toys reduces its cool-down by -5 seconds.

name: The Ninth Circle
descriptiton: Taunting a Survivor for the first time grants 1 Token. When the Exit Gates are powered and The Ninth Circle has 4 Tokens, reduce the cool-down of Bag of Toys to 1 second.
